MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING (MOU) 
 
 This Memorandum of Understanding (“ MOU ”) is entered into at Lahore on this [●] day of September 2020 (“ Effective Date ”), by and between 
 
 Zameen Venture One (Private) Limited , a private limited company registered under the laws under the laws of Pakistan and having its office at Pearl One, 94-B/I, M. M. Alam Road, Gulberg III, Lahore, Pakistan (“ Zameen ” ) 
 
 A nd 
 
 [ Name of other party ] through its authorized representative Mr. [ ● name ] son of [ ● name ], resident of House No. [ ● ], bearing CNIC [ ● ] ( the “ Investor ”). 
 
 Each also a “ Party ” and , collectively , “ Parties ”. 
 
 WHEREAS, The Parties desire to enter into the Proposed Transaction ( defined below ) and are entering into this MOU to document such desire and to initiate the discussion and negotiations with respect to the Proposed Transaction. 
 
 NOW THEREFORE , the Parties agree as follows: 
 
 DEFINITIONS 
 
 Affiliate means with respect to any entity , any other p erson or entity directly or indirectly controlling, controlled by, or under common control with such person/entity . For purposes of this definition, “control” shall mean the direct or indirect ownership of a majority shareholding or other ownership interests in such entity and the ability to elect or appoint a majority of the board of directors and otherwise to direct the management, policies and business affairs of such entity . 
 Marketing Company means Zameen Media (Private) Limited. 
 Proposed Investment means the minimum investment specified in Clause 4 (a) . 
 Proposed Transaction (s) means a potential investment opportunity with respect to an existing or proposed real estate project by Zameen for the Investor to invest in under a formal agreement . 
 Term has the same meaning assigned to it in Clause 2 ( c). 
 
 SCOPE 
 
 In connection with the Proposed T ransaction , the Parties will perform certain business and financial evaluations , as well as share and disclose certain information, in accordance with the terms and conditions of this MOU. 
 
 This MOU will be valid for a period of [ ● ] months from the date of signing hereof, or until execution of a formal agreement between the Parties with respect to the Proposed Transaction, whichever is earlier (the “ Term ”) . 
 
 PROPOSED TRANSACTION 
 
 The Proposed Transaction (s) shall be or shall be related to a new or existing real estate project undertaken or controlled by Zameen or its Affiliates, either singly or jointly. For the avoidance of doubt, undertaken shall mean where Zameen , singly or jointly, own s the project land, is the developer of the project undertaking the planning, development and construction thereof , with /or marketing, sales and promotions along with related IT and IT-enabled services undertaken by the Marketing Company. 
 
 Zameen will, from to time, share with the Investor, project feasibility plans with respect to the Proposed Transaction along with projected sales and returns on the Proposed Investment and other related requisite financial details and documents . Upon satisfaction of the Parties, the Parties will enter into a formal agreement governing the terms and conditions of the Proposed Investment . 
 
 During the Term of the MOU, the Investor may evaluate any number of Proposed Transactions presented to the Investor by Zameen . 
 
 
 PROPOSED INVESTMENT &amp; RETURNS 
 
 The Investor intends to enter into the Proposed Transaction with a minimum investment of R s. [ ● ] ( Rupees [ ● ]) (the “ Proposed Investment ”) and confirms that such funds will be available to invest at any time during the Term . 
 
 The i nvestment made by the I nvestor under the formal agreement shall be time specific and shall yield return s guaranteed on the basis of inter alia investment period , nature and type of project. However, t he I nvestor acknowledges that any such projected returns shall be subject to market conditions. 
 
 The Investor acknowledges and confirms that the Investor shall accept or reject the Proposed Transaction within the time specified by Zameen . Upon lapse of such time , the Proposed Transaction shall no longer be available for investment by the Investor . 
 
 GENERAL 
 
 The Parties represent and warrant that they have the full legal capacity and authority to enter into this MOU and the business transaction envisaged herein. 
 
 The Parties agree that the Proposed Transaction must be financially beneficial to both Parties. 
 
 The Proposed Transaction shall be structured and implemented in accordance with the applicable laws of Pakistan. 
 
 Neither Party shall be under any binding obligation to enter into the Proposed Transaction(s) if and when such business opportunity arises. 
 
 Either Party shall have the right to terminate their participation in this MOU unilaterally without cause or notice. Without prejudice to the foregoing, steps shall be taken to ensure that termination of participation in this MOU shall not be prejudicial to any agreed activities or projects undertaken within the framework of the MOU or to the completion of tasks for which obligations may exist. 
 
 T his MOU is non-binding and shall be subject to formal definitive agreements that the Parties may execute within a reasonable period of time from the date hereof. Accordingly, the Parties together may undertake detailed negotiations on financial, technical, and legal terms and conditions with a view to enter into formal agreement(s). It is further acknowledged that it is not practically possible to incorporate each and every eventuality in this MOU. Thus, it is understood and declared that any such eventuality that might be unforeseen in this MOU may be provided for in the agreement(s) with the mutual consent of the Parties thereto. 
 
 This MOU may be amended upon written mutual consent of all Parties hereto, and any such amendment shall be an integral part of this MOU. 
 
 The Parties agree to refer any dispute not resolved amicably between them to arbitration under the Arbitration Act (X of 1940). The venue of arbitration shall be Lahore and the language used shall be English. The decision and award of arbitration shall be final and binding on both Parties, including decision as to costs. 
 
 The Parties acknowledge that this MOU shall be treated as a highly confidential document and its content and any information shared by either Party in connection therewith shall not be disclosed, copied, shared, publicized or circulated in any manner whatsoever, except by mutual written consent of the disclosing Party. 
 
 Nothing contained herein shall be construed or deemed to create any association, partnership or joint venture, agency, or employer-employee relationship in any manner whatsoever between the Parties. 
 
 This MOU may be executed in one or more counterparts, each of which shall be deemed an original and all of which together shall constitute one instrument. 
 
 
 IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have signed this MOU as of the date first written above:
